workflow:
ccagent_Provision Provision an agent for CAT (Crypto Analytics Tool) 1.0.0.0 IBM
5655-EKM UKO V2R1+ ccagent
&variables;
Collection configuration Configure the properties files for the collection
Adjust configuration file catagent.properties Replace values in catagent.properties with the values from the properties file $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SERVER} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SERVER}
Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
if [ ! -f "${instance-CAT_INSTALL_DIR}/config/catagent.properties" ]; then echo "${instance-CAT_INSTALL_DIR}/config/catagent.properties does not exist, exiting" exit 1; fi
if [ ! -d "${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}" ]; then echo "Creating cat user directory ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR} because it does not exist" mkdir -p ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR} if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: Could not create directory" >&2; exit "2"; fi echo "changing access to 755" chmod 755 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR} fi
sedstring="s#cat_dsnqual=.*#cat_dsnqual=${instance-CAT_TEMP_HLQ}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*cat_kafka_uri=.*#cat_kafka_uri=${instance-CAT_KAFKA_URI}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*cat_kafka_socket=.*#cat_kafka_socket=${instance-CAT_KAFKA_URI}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*cat_kafka_transactional_id=.*#cat_kafka_transactional_id=${instance-CAT_KAFKA_TRANSACTIONAL_ID}#g;"
sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-CAT_INSTALL_DIR}/config/catagent.properties > ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties;
id -u "${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER}" if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "user ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} found, assigning ownership" chown ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "changed ownership, setting access to 600" chmod 600 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties else echo "change ownership failed, setting access to 644" chmod 644 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties fi else echo "user ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} not found, trying to assign group ownership" chgrp ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "changed ownership, setting access to 640" chmod 640 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties else echo "change ownership failed, setting access to 644" chmod 644 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catagent.properties fi fi
shell-JCL 2048
Adjust smf configuration file catsmf.conf Replace values in catsmf.conf with the values from the properties file $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SERVER} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SERVER}
Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
if [ ! -f "${instance-CAT_INSTALL_DIR}/config/catsmf.conf" ]; then echo "${instance-CAT_INSTALL_DIR}/config/catsmf.conf does not exist, exiting" exit 1; fi echo "Setting SMFGDGBASE to ${instance-SMFGDGBASE}" echo "Setting SMFGDGDONE to ${instance-SMFGDGDONE}" catsmfbase=${instance-SMFGDGBASE} sedstring="s#SMFGDGBASE.*#SMFGDGBASE(${catsmfbase})#g;" catsmfdone=${instance-SMFGDGDONE} sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*SMFGDGDONE.*#SMFGDGDONE(${catsmfdone})#g;"
sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-CAT_INSTALL_DIR}/config/catsmf.conf > ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf; id -u "${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER}" if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "user ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} found, assigning ownership" chown ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "changed ownership, setting access to 600" chmod 600 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf else echo "change ownership failed, setting access to 666" chmod 666 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf fi else echo "user ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} not found, trying to assign group ownership" chgrp ${instance-CAT_AGENT_USER} ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "changed ownership, setting access to 660" chmod 660 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf else echo "change ownership failed, setting access to 666" chmod 666 ${instance-CAT_USER_DIR}/catsmf.conf fi fi
shell-JCL
Configure security for the agent Define the required security profiles and grant access. In addition, verify dataset access manually $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY}
Submit rexx exec to execute step 1 true
rexx/defineCatAgentSecurity.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024
Run CAT collection Run the CAT collection $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY}
Submit JCL to collect 5 true
jcl/cat-run-collection.jcl JCL 80
